kind: revision-gate small loop preregistration; separate from loop10
device: CPU mocks only; no model loaded

revision_gate.weights: all expected shards present and exact SHA256 match; nonempty map
revision_gate.revision: exact pinned hash equality; never default to pin

memory_variants.control: existing config unchanged: full vision unfrozen
memory_variants.variant: vision_trainable_last_n_blocks=4; patch embed and LM LoRA remain trainable; merger and earlier vision blocks frozen
memory_variants.fallback: same variant vision_fp32=true, only on failure; at most2 attempts per variant
memory_variants.estimation: header-derived counts; frozen vision2bytes/param, trainable master4+grad4+autocast2, original Adafactor allowance and4GB workspace; estimate not measurement
memory_variants.gate: finite losses and vision; log peak memory and OOM; no new accuracy threshold

throughput.producer: bounded shard-backed smoke using SAME full config identity+manifest; no 16-image throughput substitution
throughput.gate: finite positive sample rate, exact config/manifest/device/dtype match, completed steps; full refuses absent record

storage.scope: future managed training checkpoints only; no deletion executed this loop
storage.gate: whole working directory projected usage including temporary checkpoint must stay STRICTLY below cap; refuse write otherwise; preserve failure JSONs; rotate only after successful atomic save

resume: rehash pinned base weights+revision before any model construction, including resumes; report seconds/bytes in result
tests: old revision tests first (expected red), new focused at most2 attempts then full once at end; CPU mocked only
